FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: Course playerpuzzle activity belongs to

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: name field for moodle instances

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: General introduction of the playerpuzzle activity

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Format of the intro field

FIELD.NAME: maxlevels
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of levels enabled (1-10); each level has 10 phases

FIELD.NAME: basestudenthp
FIELD.COMMENT: Base student HP at Level 1 Phase 1; scales automatically per phase

FIELD.NAME: bossavatar
FIELD.COMMENT: Boss image filename

FIELD.NAME: basebosshp
FIELD.COMMENT: Base boss HP at Level 1 Phase 1; scales automatically per phase

FIELD.NAME: bossdamage
FIELD.COMMENT: Damage dealt by boss per turn

FIELD.NAME: coingain
FIELD.COMMENT: Base coins per 3-piece Coin match; combo curve applies, does not scale by level/phase

FIELD.NAME: questioncategory
FIELD.COMMENT: Last Moodle question bank category id imported from via managequestions.php; 0 = none imported yet

FIELD.NAME: timelimit
FIELD.COMMENT: Time limit in minutes (0 means no limit)

FIELD.NAME: maxattempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Max attempts allowed (0 means unlimited)

FIELD.NAME: hud_coin_item
FIELD.COMMENT: block_playerhud item ID credited with leftover coins on victory (0 = unconfigured)

FIELD.NAME: hud_sword_item
FIELD.COMMENT: block_playerhud item ID: stock for the Espada consumable, 1 unit per use (0 = local coin purchase only)

FIELD.NAME: hud_shield_item
FIELD.COMMENT: block_playerhud item ID: stock for the Escudo consumable, 1 unit per use (0 = local coin purchase only)

FIELD.NAME: hud_potion_item
FIELD.COMMENT: block_playerhud item ID consumed 1 unit per Potion use (0 = local coin purchase only)

FIELD.NAME: hud_retry_cost_item
FIELD.COMMENT: block_playerhud item charged from the 2nd attempt onwards (0 = free)

FIELD.NAME: hud_retry_cost_qty
FIELD.COMMENT: Quantity charged per retry

FIELD.NAME: hud_win_grant_item
FIELD.COMMENT: block_playerhud item granted on every win (0 = none)

FIELD.NAME: hud_win_grant_qty
FIELD.COMMENT: Quantity granted per win

FIELD.NAME: gamemode
FIELD.COMMENT: campaign | single

FIELD.NAME: max_single_matches
FIELD.COMMENT: Single-match mode only; 0 = unlimited

FIELD.NAME: grademethod
FIELD.COMMENT: Single-match mode only; mirrors PLAYERWORDS_GRADE_*

FIELD.NAME: minquestions
FIELD.COMMENT: 0-10; applies to both modes; opt-out, not opt-in

FIELD.NAME: considererrors
FIELD.COMMENT: Boolean; only enableable when minquestions >= 1

FIELD.NAME: maxconsumables
FIELD.COMMENT: Max uses of each consumable type per attempt/match, regardless of source

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum grade value

FIELD.NAME: gradepass
FIELD.COMMENT: Minimum passing grade

FIELD.NAME: duedate
FIELD.COMMENT: Deadline shown as a calendar event; 0 = no deadline

FIELD.NAME: completionattempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Custom completion rule: minimum finished attempts (0 = rule disabled)

FIELD.NAME: completionwins
FIELD.COMMENT: Custom completion rule: minimum won attempts/matches (0 = rule disabled)

TABLE.NAME: playerpuzzle_attempts
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores user attempts, tokens, and final scores for the activity

FIELD.NAME: playerpuzzleid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playerpuzzle

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to user

FIELD.NAME: token
FIELD.COMMENT: Security token for anti-cheat verification

FIELD.NAME: currentlevel
FIELD.COMMENT: Level this attempt was played on (1-10)

FIELD.NAME: currentphase
FIELD.COMMENT: Phase this attempt was played on (1-10)

FIELD.NAME: difficulty
FIELD.COMMENT: Student-chosen difficulty for this run: easy, normal or hard. Locked once the attempt is in progress

FIELD.NAME: isdemo
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether this is a disposable Demo attempt (Lobby's Jogar Demo button): fixed HP, never counted for grade/coins/completion/attempt-limit. Set once at creation from the request

FIELD.NAME: bosshp_remaining
FIELD.COMMENT: Boss HP left when game ended

FIELD.NAME: questions_correct
FIELD.COMMENT: Total questions answered correctly

FIELD.NAME: questions_total
FIELD.COMMENT: Total questions prompted

FIELD.NAME: coins_earned
FIELD.COMMENT: Server-ratcheted coin ledger for the current phase/match, capped by a damage-based ceiling

FIELD.NAME: boss_coins_earned
FIELD.COMMENT: Same ledger, boss side; nets against coins_earned at payout

FIELD.NAME: coins_spent
FIELD.COMMENT: Coins spent on source=local consumable purchases this phase/match

FIELD.NAME: combatstate
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON snapshot of the in-progress board/combat, for resuming after a reload; null = no fight in progress for the current phase

FIELD.NAME: currentquestionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Question drawn server-side and currently open for this attempt (0 = none); the client never chooses which question is in play

FIELD.NAME: score
FIELD.COMMENT: Final calculated grade

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: Status: inprogress, won, lost, timeout, abandoned

FIELD.NAME: timefinished
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp when attempt ended; 0 if still in progress

TABLE.NAME: playerpuzzle_attempt_questions
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per question the student answered during an attempt, for the post-game review and teacher report

FIELD.NAME: attemptid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playerpuzzle_attempts

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Source question id in the Moodle question bank

FIELD.NAME: attemptlevel
FIELD.COMMENT: Level the question was answered on

FIELD.NAME: attemptphase
FIELD.COMMENT: Phase the question was answered on

FIELD.NAME: questiontext
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot of the question text at answer time

FIELD.NAME: chosenanswer
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot of the answer the student chose

FIELD.NAME: correctanswer
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot of the correct answer

FIELD.NAME: iscorrect
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the chosen answer was correct

TABLE.NAME: playerpuzzle_attempt_consumables
TABLE.COMMENT: Counts consumable uses per attempt, for the maxconsumables limit; one row per type actually used

FIELD.NAME: attemptid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playerpuzzle_attempts

FIELD.NAME: consumabletype
FIELD.COMMENT: potion | shield | magic | sword

FIELD.NAME: timesused
FIELD.COMMENT: Uses so far, regardless of source (local coin or PlayerHUD stock)

TABLE.NAME: playerpuzzle_questions
TABLE.COMMENT: PlayerPuzzle's own question bank: manually entered and/or AI-generated questions, per instance

FIELD.NAME: playerpuzzleid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playerpuzzle

FIELD.NAME: qtype
FIELD.COMMENT: multichoice | truefalse

FIELD.NAME: questiontextformat
FIELD.COMMENT: FORMAT_* constant for questiontext; 2=FORMAT_PLAIN today, ready for rich text once the manual form gains a file-capable editor

FIELD.NAME: hint
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional hint text; feeds the Question Hint consumable

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: manual | ai | bank

FIELD.NAME: sourceid
FIELD.COMMENT: When source=bank: the question_bank_entries.id it was imported from, used to match on re-sync. Null otherwise

FIELD.NAME: approved
FIELD.COMMENT: Manual/bank questions are approved on entry; ai-generated ones start at 0 until the teacher approves

FIELD.NAME: addedby
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to user: who entered it manually, or who triggered the AI generation

TABLE.NAME: playerpuzzle_question_answers
TABLE.COMMENT: Answer options for a playerpuzzle_questions row; truefalse questions store two rows here too (Verdadeiro/Falso), so validate_answer.php has one read path for both qtypes

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playerpuzzle_questions

FIELD.NAME: answerformat
FIELD.COMMENT: FORMAT_* constant for answertext; 2=FORMAT_PLAIN today, ready for rich text once the manual form gains a file-capable editor
